title: Rehearsal
text: Since the Foundry, the log has started writing ahead of you. Lines appear a second before the things they describe. "Pod 2: nutrient cycle." Then pod 2's nutrient cycle. "Drone 4: idle." Then drone 4 stops. As if something is rehearsing.

lines.text: "It's predicting you. Or it's practising being you. I can't tell which from the timestamps, and I have tried."

choices.label: Watch it
choices.reply: You watch your own log arrive early, all night. Twice it is wrong. You take some comfort in that.

choices.label: Shut the log
choices.reply: You close the log. The lines keep coming. They go somewhere else now.

effects.text: origin confirmed: cinder. run 12 within 3% of close. prepare.

notes: Fires at home after the Foundry (foundry-found): the Clause wakes sooner (+3 lead).
